free_text: The patient is a 56-year-old male with a PSA of 5.2 and a biopsy-proven adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 3+3 (ISUP grade group 1). MRI showed a PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right peripheral zone base, correlating with a clinical T stage cT2a. Management assessment is pending clinical review regarding individual treatment benefit and patient preferences. The trade-off involves balancing the risk of progression against the potential benefits of active treatment for this low-grade cancer.
